protocol.data: Train Session1 only; no cross-session claim
protocol.outer: 5-fold subject holdout; 4 unknown and 16 registered subjects per fold
protocol.known_outer_test: last 20% trials within each registered subject/task
protocol.inner: 2-fold pseudo-unknown; thresholds selected once per view
protocol.pair_rule: same task, reciprocal nearest, similarity>0.99; asymmetric defense also requires gap>0.005
protocol.targeted_attack: deterministic next class in the enrolled class order
protocol.model_selection: no outer-fold retuning; at most three candidates
